name: tramela-estate
description: Shared operations and click-and-collect platform for regional ironmongery, paint and garden-hardware shops.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.mjs && esbuild src/client/main.tsx --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --jsx=automatic --outfile=dist/public/app.js --loader:.woff2=file && cp -R public/. dist/public/ && cp src/client/index.html dist/public/index.html && cp src/client/styles.css dist/public/app.css
